observations.title: Flerovium role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Optimizes item, particle and entity rendering using culling and reduced repeated work. Forge 1.20.1 uses Embeddium; newer NeoForge descriptions involving Sodium are version-specific.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 1.2.19

observations.title: Narrated guide corroboration with loader caveat
observations.player_action: Compare the narrated chapter with installed author documentation before changing a setting.
observations.outcome: The guide separates rendering optimizations from world simulation.
conditions: The 2025-11-20 video discusses NeoForge and multiple Minecraft versions; it cannot establish an installed Forge 1.20.1 option, benchmark or exact implementation.
Automatic Spanish captions can misrecognize names; the author project and installed static source remain necessary corroboration.
